action: Consumers having these tug boats should take them away from children and return them to the nearest Toys "R" Us, Inc. store for a full refund of the purchase price.
incidents_text: While neither the CPSC nor Toys "R" Us, Inc. is aware of any injuries associated with the toy boats, this corrective action is being taken to prevent the possibility.
sold_at: These toy boats were sold nationwide from August to December 1988 through Toys "R" Us, Inc. stores for approximately $4.99.

heading: Coca-Cola Foods Recalls Its "Cool Cuffs"
hazard_text: The CPSC is concerned the plastic locking device which holds the bracelet in place could be removed and become a choking hazard for small children.
action: Coca-Cola Foods and the CPSC advise consumers who have "Cool Cuff" in their homes to take the item away from children under three years of age and discard it, or return it to Hi-C Stick-on Cool Cuff, P.O. Box 1133, Maple Plains, MN 55348 for replacement with a premium of similar value.
incidents_text: There have been no reported injuries involving the small parts in this item.

heading: Artsana Of America (Chicco) Voluntarily Begins A Corrective Action On "Spinning Bee" Toy
hazard_text: The rubber disc-like feet constitute small parts which can cause a choking, ingestion, or aspiration hazard to children.
action: Consumers should remove all four rubber feet and send them to Chicco at: Artsana of America/Chicco, 200 Fifth Avenue - Room 910, New York, NY 10010. Chicco, upon receipt of the feet, will issue a $3.00 gift certificate toward the purchase of another Chicco Toy.

heading: Christmas Stocking Decorative Bear Recalled As Choking Hazard
hazard_text: Two small bells on the front of the stocking can easily come off and may be a choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers should immediately take the stocking away from infants and return the product to the retailer where purchased for a full refund.
incidents_text: Neither the Jerry Elsner Company nor the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission is aware of any injuries associated with the product.

heading: Lionel Leisure, Inc. Recalling Snoopy Wind-Up Train Because Of Small Parts
hazard_text: The toy breaks apart on impact, creating small parts which could cause choking in young children.
action: Consumers should take the toy away from young children immediately and return it to the store where purchased for a refund or exchange.
incidents_text: Neither the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission nor Lionel Leisure, Inc. is aware of any injuries associated with this product.

heading: Choking Hazard Prompts Pacifier Holder Recall
hazard_text: The metal clip may come loose from the disc and could pose a choking hazard to infants.
action: Consumers having the older "Mother's Helper" pacifier holders should remove the holders from infants and toddlers, then return the product to the store for a full refund of the purchase price. Holders may also be sent directly to Steven Barrie & Company, 1055A Louis Drive, Warminster, PA 18970 for a refund of the purchase price and postage.
incidents_text: Neither the company nor the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission is aware of any injuries associated with the recalled pacifier holders.

product_name: Mullins Square baby bibs, pants and panties
heading: Potential Choking Hazard Leads To Recall Of Baby Bibs, Pants, Panties
hazard_text: The recalled bibs, pants and panties have decorative plastic eyes which could be removed by infants and be ingested.
action: Consumers having the recalled infant wearing apparel should return the product to the retailer with the sales receipt for a refund of the purchase price. If no receipt, the retailer will return the product to Mullins Square who will replace the hazardous eyes and return the unit to the consumer at no cost.
units: About 11,000 sets of baby pants and panties, and about 15,000 sets of bibs
incidents_text: While no known choking incidents have been reported to date, the company is recalling the apparel to prevent the possibility of such accidents from occurring.

product_name: Speed Queen Contempo Mate Stack combination washer-dryer
heading: Rent-A-Center Announces A Retrofit Program For Owners Or Users Of Speed Queen Contempo Mate Washer/Dryer Equipped With Caster -- Rollers
hazard_text: The casters elevate the appliance high enough off the floor to allow children to contact some of the washer's moving parts.
action: Rent-A-Center customers owning or renting the Speed Queen Contempo Mate Stack Washer/Dryer with caster-rollers should call Rent-A-Center toll-free at 1-800-666-8186 to obtain the free guard kit, obtain help in installing the guard, or for other information about the retrofit program.

heading: Franklin Sports Industries, Inc, Recalls All Of Its Lawn Darts
hazard_text: The blunt metal tips of the yard darts may pose a risk of injury, especially to children.
action: Consumers that have these yard darts should stop using the darts immediately and return just the four darts directly to: Yard Dart Recall, Franklin Sports Industries, Inc., Parkway, Stoughton, MA 02072. Consumers will receive $5.00 directly from Franklin Sports Industries, Inc. for the return of the four yard darts.

heading: Potential Strangulation Risk Prompts Baby Mirror Recall
hazard_text: The flexible plastic edging may separate from the mirror and could present a strangulation risk to infants.
action: Consumers who have a "Bright Reflections" mirror should remove it from children and return it to the retailer for a refund of the purchase price. To obtain a new mirror, with the edging securely attached, consumers may return their mirrors directly to G. Pierce Toy Manufacturing Company, 4420 S. Wolcott Street, Chicago, IL 60609.
incidents_text: The company has received one complaint that a child's head became entrapped between the edging and the mirror. Although no injury occurred, the firm is recalling these mirrors to prevent future injuries from occurring.
sold_at: The majority of these crib mirrors were sold nationally in Toys R Us stores between December 1987 and October 1988 for approximately $10.

product_name: "Crib Pals Tiny Tinkers Rattle Copter" and "Crib Pals Tiny Tinkers" set
heading: Toys R Us Recalling 12,000 Baby Rattles
hazard_text: Shaped like a toy helicopter, the rattle copter has a tail section which is long enough to reach the back of an infant's throat and possibly cause choking. In addition, a small yellow cap at the top of the copter may come off and could pose a choking hazard.
action: Consumers who bought the rattle copter singly or as part of the three-piece rattle set should take the rattle away from infants immediately and return the product to the nearest Toys R Us store for a refund of the full purchase price.
sold_at: The toy helicopter rattle was sold individually and as part of a three-piece rattle set. Toys R Us sold the rattles singly as "Crib Pals Tiny Tinkers Rattle Copter," #SKN331139, for $4. The three-piece "Crib Pals Tiny Tinkers," SKN331244, included two other rattles, a carry-along clock and a dial-and-spin rattle, which do not pose choking hazards to infants; the combination set retailed for $10.

product_name: "Crib Activity Play Doggie" and "Play Mirror" crib toys; "Sweet Heart Babies" dolls
heading: Choking Hazard Prompts Recall Of Crib Toys, Dolls
hazard_text: Small parts of the toys may present choking hazards to young children.
action: Parents should immediately take the toys away from young children and return them to the store where purchased for a refund of the full purchase price.
units: Approximately 21,000 "Crib Activity Play Doggie" toys, 37,000 "Play Mirror" toys, and 190,000 "Sweet Heart Babies" dolls
incidents_text: No injuries have been reported.

heading: "Cutie Pie" Dolls Recalled For Potential Choking Hazards
hazard_text: The doll's arms can be pulled off and may present choking hazards to young children.
action: Consumers having "Cutie Pie" dolls should immediately take them away from young children and return the doll and accessories to the store where purchased for a refund of the full purchase price.
incidents_text: No injuries involving the dolls have been reported to the firms or to the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission.

product_name: "Learn and Play Pal" and "Soft Sisters" dolls
heading: Choking Hazard Leads To Recall Of 2 Dolls
hazard_text: The buttons or a buckle on the clothing of the dolls could come off and present a choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers having any of the dolls with buttons or buckles on the clothing should immediately remove the buttons and buckles or take the dolls away from young children and return the dolls to the store where purchased for a refund of the full purchase price.

heading: Blue Box Crib Toy Recalled
hazard_text: Five-month-old infants can pull themselves up to a hanging crib toy and may become entangled or fall forward over it, possibly strangling. Consumers may attach strings or ribbons to the toy for use in a full-size crib, which could increase the risk of strangulation.
action: Consumers with the Blue-Box crib gym should return it to the retailer for a refund of the purchase price.
incidents_text: No strangulations or injuries have been reported.

heading: Eyes And Nose Are Choking-Hazards On Koala Bear Fur Banks
hazard_text: The yellow plastic eyes and black plastic noses of the bears can be pulled off and may be ingested or choked on.
action: The U. S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) and the distributor, ACE Novelty Company, Bellevue, Washington advise consumers to: 1) destroy the banks, or 2) remove and destroy both the eyes and the nose.

heading: Potential Strangulation Risk Prompts Toys R Us To Recall Crib Toy
hazard_text: These toys have a looped cord with a teether attached to its body long enough to fit over an infant's head and present a potential risk of strangulation.
action: Consumers should take the toy away from children and return it to the nearest Toys R Us store for a refund of the purchase price.
incidents_text: No strangulations or injuries have been reported.
sold_at: "Curiosity Snail" was sold nationally for about $14 in Toys R Us stores this year.

product_name: Model #1595 Batting Tee with Return Ball Trainer, Model #1597 Return Ball Trainer, Model #1598 Complete Teeball Set, and Model #1758 Return Kick Soccer Skill Trainer
heading: Franklin Sports Recalls Baseball, Soccer Training Sets
hazard_text: The metal stakes or spikes used to anchor the products to the ground may pose a risk of injury if improperly used.
action: Consumers who have these items are asked to stop using them immediately and return only the stake/cord/ball or spike directly to: Stake Recall, Franklin Sports Industries, Inc., 17 Campanelli Parkway, Stoughton, Mass. 02072. Consumers will receive $5.00 from Franklin Sports for the returned items.
incidents_text: The firm has had two reports of children being struck by the stake during unusual use.

heading: Toy Fire Boat Recalled By Target Stores
hazard_text: The smokestack of the boat can break off and may cause choking in young children.
action: Consumers should take the toy boat away from young children immediately and return it to the nearest Target Store for a refund of the full purchase price.
incidents_text: The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) or Target Stores is not aware of any injuries associated with the toy.
sold_at: The toys were sold in Target Stores nationwide last fall for $4.99 each.

heading: Choking Hazard Prompts Rite-Aide Doll Recall
hazard_text: Some of the dolls' arms and legs can come off and may cause choking in young children.
action: Consumers should take the dolls away from young children immediately and return them to the nearest Rite-Aide store for a full refund of the purchase price.
sold_at: The dolls were imported from Hong Kong by Lovee Doll Company and approximately 1,000 dolls were sold in Rite-Aide stores for about $5.00 in late summer of 1988.

heading: Choking Hazard Prompts Recall Of Flower Rattle
hazard_text: The rattle may break and the pieces may pose a choking hazard to infants and young children.
action: Consumers should immediately take the flower rattle away from infants and return the product to the retailer where purchased for a full refund.

heading: Toy Kitchen Is Recalled; Parts May Cause Choking
hazard_text: Small plastic parts may come off the toy and could pose a choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers should immediately take the toy away from young children and return it to the store where purchased for a refund of the full purchase price.

heading: Customs' Seizure Leads To Recall Of Toy Rattles
hazard_text: Spheres at both ends of the rattle may break into pieces which present a potential choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers should immediately take the rattle away from infants and return it to the store where purchased for a refund of the full purchase price. This rattle may also be returned to Stahlwood Toy Manufacturing Company, 58-30 Grand Avenue, Maspeth, N.Y. 11378 for a full refund.
incidents_text: Neither CPSC nor the manufacturer is aware of any injuries associated with this product.

product_name: Doll #5219; Baby Doll #5386; Crawling Baby Doll #5602; Sitting Baby Doll #5603; Dressed Doll with Crystal Eyes #5613; Sitting Doll with Yarn Hair #5406, Plastic Clothespin #6599, Plastic Spoon #6600, Plastic Safety Pin #6601, Plastic Telephone #6638, and Plastic Rattle #6640
heading: Craft Dolls And Rattles Recalled For Possible Choking Hazards
hazard_text: The dolls are being recalled because the arms and/or heads can be pulled off and choked on by a young child. These rattles are small enough to fit into an infant's mouth, and long enough to reach the back of the throat and cause choking.
action: Consumers who purchased these dolls and rattles should immediately take them away from young children and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund of the purchase price.
sold_at: Sold in craft stores, the dolls and rattles were marketed as decorations.

heading: Kellogg Company Voluntarily Recalls Two Toy Premiums
hazard_text: When subjected to use and abuse testing, these premiums may break into small parts and pose a potential choking hazard to children under three years of age.
action: Kellogg Company and the CPSC want to inform consumers who have a "Cool Flute" (from Corn POPS only) or "Binoculars" in their homes to take them away from children under three years of age and discard them, or return the toy to Kellogg Company for reimbursement. If reimbursement is desired, consumers may send either toy to Kellogg Company, P.O. Box 3599, Battle Creek, MI 49016.
incidents_text: While Kellogg has received no complaints of injuries related to children playing with a "Cool Flute," one choking incident, which did not result in serious injury, was reported to the CPSC. No complaints of injuries involving playing with the "Binoculars" have been reported.

heading: New Infant Strangulation Prompts Second Recall Of Child Enclosures
hazard_text: Toddlers between 10 and 24 months of age are at the greatest risk because they can climb on the enclosure, and may slip and catch their head or neck in the V-shaped openings at the top of the enclosure. They may also attempt to crawl through and become entrapped in the diamond-shaped openings in the middle of the enclosure.
action: As an incentive to return the enclosure, consumers will receive a $10 cash refund or a $15 coupon which may be used toward the purchase of any product manufactured by Nu-Line industries, Paris Manufacturing Corporation, or Northstates Industries, Inc.
incidents_text: These enclosures have been involved in at least seventeen incidents resulting in four deaths.

heading: Safety Pin Rattle Recalled as Potential Choking Hazard
hazard_text: The rattle is small enough to fit into an infant's mouth, and long enough to reach the back of the throat and possibly cause choking.
action: Consumers who purchased the recalled Safety Pin Rattles should immediately take them away from infants and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund of the purchase price.
sold_at: Sold in craft stores, the rattles were marketed as decorations.

product_name: Stretch Tail Pop, Whistling Funny Action and Busy Animals wind-up toys
heading: Choking Hazards Prompt Recall Of Imported Toys
hazard_text: The wind-up toys have small parts that could present a choking hazard to children. Klacker balls are banned because the balls may separate from the string and could cause injury to users or bystanders.
action: Consumers should immediately take the toys away from children and destroy the toys or return them to the store of purchase for a full refund.

product_name: Plastic Racing Cars item C805, Plastic Jetplanes item C822, and Plastic Speedcycle item C900
heading: Acme Premium Supply Corp. Recalls Plastic Racing Cars, Jetplanes and Speedcycles
hazard_text: On all three toys, the small wheels may present a potential choking hazard for young children.
action: Although the CPSC and Acme Premium Supply Corp. have not received reports of any injuries involving these plastic toys, consumers should take the toys away from young children and discard them.
incidents_text: CPSC and Acme Premium Supply Corp. have not received reports of any injuries involving these plastic toys.

heading: Consumers Were Urged To Replace Horn On Century Roadster Walker
hazard_text: The horn is located in the center of the steering wheel and can be torn or bitten off by a child occupant, posing a potential choking hazard.
action: To prevent a potential choking hazard, consumers are urged to remove the horn immediately from the steering wheel by grasping the horn with pliers and pulling the horn out. The replacement horn is no longer available. Please remove the horn, and then discard or destroy it.
incidents_text: There have been eleven potential choking incidents reported, including one in which a horn piece was removed from a child's mouth to prevent his choking.

product_name: E-Z Go umbrella strollers, models 11-066DI and 11-077SA; and Sears Infant Umbrella-Style Stroller, model 11-074SR
heading: Century Recalling E-Z Go Strollers
hazard_text: Century Products Company said seat backs and a rear locking brace may not perform properly. When a toddler strapped in, the stroller leans too far forward, or if the stroller comes to an abrupt stop, the child may fall forward and strike his head. Also, when the person pushing the stroller accidentally kicks the rear locking brace, the stroller will fold on the child, whose fingers could be pinched as the adult attempts to re-open the stroller.
action: Consumers having the stroller should stop using the product and discard or destroy the product. The return program is no longer available.

product_name: Franklin yard darts: Model #3210 Yard Dart Set, Model #3283 Three Game Combination Set, Model #3284 Three Game Combination Set, and Model #3287 Five Game Combination Set
heading: Franklin Sports Industries, Inc. Recalls All Of Its Lawn Darts
hazard_text: The yard dart sets are being recalled because the blunt metal tips may pose a risk of injury, especially to children.
action: Consumers that have these yard darts should stop using the darts immediately and return just the four darts directly to: Yard Dart Recall, Franklin Sports Industries, 17 Campanelli Parkway, Stoughton, MA 02072. Consumers will receive $5.00 directly from Franklin Sports Industries, Inc. for the return of the four yard darts.

product_name: New Bright Model 41179 "Talking Silver Rail Express" train sets
heading: "Silver Rail Express" Toy Train Recalled Because Of Potential Fire Hazard
hazard_text: The battery-powered toy train sets can short-circuit and cause the tender car to overheat, posing a potential fire hazard.
action: New Bright Industries is offering a free replacement train set to owners of 1986 train sets. For information about obtaining a free replacement as well as assistance in identifying models affected by this recall announcement, consumers should call New Bright Industries toll-free number at 877-624-8697 or online at https://www.newbright.com. Consumers may also write to New Bright Industries, 41911 Ford Road, Canton, MI 48187.
incidents_text: New Bright Industries has received 16 complaints of toy train sets short-circuiting, causing the coal tender car to overheat. No injuries have been reported; however, consumers have reported nine incidents of the train catching fire.

heading: Toy Motorboat Recalled; Seized During CPSC/U.S. Customs Operation
hazard_text: The propeller of the wind-up boat can come off and may cause choking in young children.
action: Consumers should take the toy away from young children immediately and return it to the store where purchased for a refund of the purchase price, or exchange it for a toy of similar value.
incidents_text: Neither the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) nor Child World Inc. is aware of injuries associated with this toy.

product_name: Crib Pals "Kitty Cat Lion Rattle" and "Playtime Pals" rattles
heading: Toys-R-Us Recalls 8 Crib Rattles
hazard_text: The recalled rattles failed to meet the mandatory standard for rattles and may pose a choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers having any of the rattles should immediately take them away from children and return them to the nearest Toys-R-Us store for a refund of the full purchase price.
units: Approximately 2,500 "Kitty Cat Lion" rattles and approximately 13,000 "Playtime Pets" rattle sets
incidents_text: Toys-R-Us or the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) is not aware of any injuries associated with the rattles to date.
sold_at: Sold in Toy-R-Us stores nationwide, the recalled rattles include a "Kitty Cat Lion Rattle" and a set of seven "Playtime Pals" rattles.

heading: Pop Up Phone Recalled; Antenna Is Choking Hazard
hazard_text: An antenna piece may separate from the toy telephone receiver and cause a potential choking hazard for young children.
action: Parents having model #1808-0 "Pop Up Answer Phone" not marked with a red dot should immediately take the toy away from young children and return it to the store where purchased for a refund of the full purchase price, or mail the toy to Larami Corporation, 340 North 12th Street, Philadelphia, PA 19107.

product_name: "Walt Disney Mickey Mouse Baby Play Gyms"
heading: Toy Firm Recalls Disney Baby Play Gyms
hazard_text: The buckles and loops of the gym are small enough to be ingested by an infant. In addition, the mirrored rattle may break into small parts and may present a potential choking hazard if it comes off the strap.
action: Consumers having a gym set with plastic or unstitched fabric straps holding the figures and rattle to the crossbar should immediately take the toys away from infants and toddlers and request replacement straps, buckles, and rattles by writing to the Consumer Service Department, Illco Toy Company, 200 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York 10010.

heading: "Love Me Tender" Dolls Recalled By Tonka Products
hazard_text: The plastic eyes may come off and could present a choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers are urged to take the dolls away from young children and return the dolls either to the place of purchase or to Tonka Products, Attention: Department K, 2950 Robertson Avenue, Cincinnati, OH 45209, for a full refund of the purchase price.
incidents_text: The company acknowledged having received 76 reports from consumers about the dolls where the eyes had come off. While no injuries have been reported, the company said it is recalling the dolls to prevent any ingestion of small parts.

product_name: Speed Queen Contempo Mate Stack Washer-Dryer
heading: Speed Queen Announces A Retrofit Program For Contempo Mate Stack Washer-Dryer Equipped With Caster-Rollers
hazard_text: Speed Queen Company of Ripon, Wisconsin, is voluntarily offering a retrofit program for its caster-equipped Contempo Stack combination washer-dryer to eliminate the possibility that consumers could receive a hand or foot injury from the appliance when operating.
action: Consumers having the Speed Queen Contempo Mate tack washer-dryer with casters should call Speed Queen toll-free at 1-800-543-3462 to obtain the free guard kit, obtain help in installing the guard, or for other information about the retrofit program.

product_name: Donald Duck, Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse plastic toy figures
heading: Importer Recalls Toys Sold At Ice Shows
hazard_text: The arms of the three toys, and also Donald Duck's legs and hat, can be pulled off and may present a choking hazard to young children.
action: Parents should immediately take the toys away from young children, and send them to Sells Floto, Inc., 3201 New Mexico Avenue, Washington, D.C. 20016 for a refund of the full purchase.
sold_at: The plastic toy figures were sold at Ringling Brothers production of "Walt Disney's World on Ice" shows.

product_name: Neiman-Marcus Gift-Wrap Box Ornaments: Fuzzy yellow duck and wooden Hansel and Gretel ornaments
heading: Neiman-Marcus Recalls Gift Ornaments As Possible Hazards For Children
hazard_text: The fuzzy yellow duck contains a possible aspiration or choking hazard to young children because its one-quarter-inch black plastic eyes can be pulled off. The painted, wooden Hansel and Gretel decoration may present a potential lead poisoning hazard because paint on the decoration contains lead in excess of the 0.06% limit.
action: Consumers who received the ducks or the Hansel and Gretel decorations as a part of Neiman-Marcus Gift-wrapped Boxes should return them to a Neiman-Marcus store for a refund of the gift-wrap price.
units: Approximately 6,000 ducks and 11,000 Hansel and Gretel decorations
sold_at: The fuzzy, squeaking duck was attached to Neiman-Marcus gift-wrapped boxes between January 1, 1988 and April 30, 1988, and the wooden Hansel and Gretel decoration was attached to Neiman-Marcus gift-wrapped boxes between January 1, 1987 and December 31, 1987.

product_name: "Baby's First Squeeze Toys," "Baby's First Playball" squeeze toys, and "Telephone Receiver Rattle" toys
heading: K Mart Recalls Squeeze Toys & Telephone Rattles
hazard_text: The squeakers in the squeeze toys may come out and could present a potential choking hazard to children under three years of age. The rattles are shaped like a telephone receiver. They may break and produce plastic pieces and beads, which could present a choking hazard and may cut infants.
action: Consumers should immediately take the squeeze toys and rattles away from infants and return them to any K Mart store for a full refund of the purchase price.
units: Approximately 81,000 "Baby's First Squeeze Toys," 75,000 "Baby's First Playball" squeeze toys, and 33,000 plastic "Telephone Receiver Rattles"
sold_at: The "Baby's First Squeeze Toys" and "Baby's First Playball" squeeze toys sold for less than $1.00 at K Mart stores since November 1987, and the "Telephone Receiver Rattles" sold for less than $2 in stores since December, 1987.

heading: Consumers Warned About Proper Assembly of "Crawl Space" Children's Enclosure
hazard_text: The enclosure must be assembled with the metal legs on the outside of the mesh and away from the child; otherwise the child may become caught between a leg and netting and may suffocate.
action: Care should be taken to ensure that this product is being properly used. Consumers should contact Gerber Furniture Group to receive warning labels for the Crawl Space and instruction sheet showing proper assembly.
incidents_text: The company is aware of one incident in which a child allegedly suffocated as a result of being caught between the netting and a metal leg.

heading: Shake 'N Sort Rattles Recalled By Playskool
hazard_text: Some of the rattles made prior to 1988 may separate and release small beads which may be a potential choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers should immediately take the rattle away from young children, and return it to the store where purchased for a full refund of the purchase price. Rattles may also be sent directly to Playskool, Inc., PO Box 200, Pawtucket, RI 02862-0200 for a refund.
incidents_text: Neither Playskool, Inc. nor the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission is aware of any injuries associated with this product.

product_name: Fibre Craft dolls and rattle decorations
heading: CPSC Issues Correction of Craft Dolls Model Numbers Announced In Recall
hazard_text: The rattles are small enough to fit into an infant's mouth, and long enough to reach the back of the throat and cause choking. The dolls are being recalled because their arms may be pulled off and possibly ingested by a young child.
action: Consumers who purchased the recalled rattles or dolls should take them away from children and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund of the purchase price.
sold_at: Sold in craft stores, the rattles and dolls were marketed as decorations.

heading: K Mart Recalling Scissors Desk Set
hazard_text: A razor blade cutting knife in the set may pose a serious laceration hazard to young children.
action: Consumers should remove the scissors set from young children, and return it to the nearest K-Mart store for a refund of the purchase price.
sold_at: The desk set sold for less than $1 at K Mart stores during July 1988.

heading: Baby Rattle With Whistle Recalled By N.Y. Importer
hazard_text: The rattle's handle is small enough to enter a child's mouth, and is long enough to reach the back of the throat. In addition, a metal bell can become separated from the top of the rattle and be ingested by a young child.
action: Parents should take the rattle away from infants immediately, then return it to the retail store where purchased, or send it to Everlast Industrial Company (U.S.A.) Ltd., 519 Eighth Avenue Lobby, New York, N.Y. 10018 for a refund of the full purchase price.

heading: "Squeaky Ducky" Toy Recalled
hazard_text: The company is recalling this product because the vinyl separation may present a choking hazard.
action: Consumers who have a "Squeaky Duck" toy with a BLUE background around the yellow duck should return the toy to the manufacturer for replacement with a new product at the following address: Consumer Relations Manager, Kiddie Products, Inc., One Kiddie Drive, Avon, MA 02322, RE: Blue/Duck Recall
incidents_text: The company received 27 complaints that the top layer of the toy's vinyl cover separated from the soft foam squeaker toy. In three cases consumers reported that children had mouthed the cover.

heading: TDT Company Recalls Two Rainbow Bell Baby Rattles
hazard_text: The rattles present a choking hazard to infants. The handles of both rattles are small enough to enter a child's mouth and long enough to reach the back of the throat. The metal bells can also detach.
action: Consumers should return the rattles to the retail store where purchased for a full refund of the purchase price.
incidents_text: Neither CPSC nor TDT Company knows of any injuries caused by these rattles.

product_name: Baby Guards Disney Hand Holder No.9560; and Baby Guards Sesame Street Hand Holder No. 9562
heading: Playskool Baby, Inc. Recalls Hand Holders
hazard_text: Some of the painted Mickey Mouse and Big Bird characters on the wristbands may contain excess levels of lead and, if ingested, may present a potential lead poisoning hazard.
action: Consumers should discontinue use of the products and return them to the retail store where purchased for a full refund of the purchase price. Consumers may also return the products to Playskool Baby, Inc., PO Box 200, Pawtucket, RI 02862-0200 for a full refund.
incidents_text: Neither Hasbro, Inc. nor CPSC is aware of any injuries or deaths associated with these products.

product_name: "Pull Along Bear Brother" and "Pull Along Happy Bear"
heading: Importer Recalls Two Pull-Along Toys
hazard_text: Small parts may separate from the toys and present a choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers should remove the toys from children and return them to the store for a refund of the full purchase price.

heading: Rainbow Kids Dolls Recalled By Importer
hazard_text: The arms and shoes can come off and present a choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers should immediately take the dolls away from young children and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund.
incidents_text: Neither the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission nor the Oriental Trading Company is aware of any reports of injuries involving the doll.

heading: "Royal" Baby Rattles Recalled By Importer
hazard_text: The handles of the rattle present a choking hazard to infants.
action: Consumers should take the rattles away from children and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund.

heading: Wang's International Recalls Craft Dolls
hazard_text: These dolls have arms which may be pulled off and present a choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers who purchased these dolls should take them away from young children and return the dolls to the place of purchase for a full refund of the purchase price.
incidents_text: Neither CPSC nor Wang's International know of any injuries involving these craft dolls.

heading: Fisher-Price To Modify "Pop-Up Playhouse" Toy
hazard_text: When assembled, the support structure is held together under tension. If any of the tubes break, or for some other reason the tension is released, the playhouse parts can come apart and be forcefully and rapidly thrown or ejected from the toy.
action: Consumers with the playhouse should immediately remove the toy from children, then fold it according to instructions that came with the product. Consumers should not disassemble the playhouse until they receive the free modification kit and instructions. Consumers should call Fisher-Price toll-free at 1-800-233-4004 for the kit.
incidents_text: Fisher-Price has received approximately 100 reports from consumers about parts of the children's playhouse suddenly coming apart, and parts being hurled across a room with enough force to break glass, stick in drywall or cause other property damage. Although several consumers have reported being struck in the eye or face, none of the injuries required hospitalization, and most of the incidents did not involve injury.

heading: Toys-R-Us Recalling Toy Stationery Sets
hazard_text: A razor blade cutting knife in the stationary set may pose a potential laceration hazard to young children.
action: Consumers having the stationery set should take the toy away from children, then return it to the nearest Toys-R-Us store for a full refund of the purchase price.
sold_at: Imported from Taiwan, the toy stationery set was sold in Toys-R-Us stores between October and December 1987 for $7.99.

product_name: "Big Mouth Fish, Hippo, and Frog" water toy, "Devil Fish" water toy, and "Lively Squeaking Snake" toy
heading: Importer Recalls Water Toys; Toy Snake
hazard_text: Both water toys have small parts, which may present a choking hazard to young children, and the toy snake contains an excessive amount of lead in the surface coating.
action: Consumers should immediately take the toys away from children and return them to the retail store for a refund of the purchase price.

product_name: "Musical Cab" wind-up and battery-powered toy cars
heading: Toy Cars Recalled
hazard_text: The balls on the umbrellas and other small parts can come off and present a choking hazard to young children.
action: Consumers should immediately take the toys away from children, discard the toys or return them to the retail store where purchased for a full refund.
units: Approximately 4,800 wind-up models and 3,600 battery-powered models

product_name: Blazon-Flexible Flyer, Inc. "Gym Sets" and "Horse Attachment"
heading: Retrofit Program Announced for Blazon-Flexible Flyer, Inc. "Gym Sets" And "Horse Attachment"
hazard_text: The potential hazard involves breakage due to wear of plastic tube end bearing brackets connecting the Teeter Totter, Lawn Swing and Horse Attachment, to the top support bar of the Gym Set. Breakage of this connection may cause the unit to fall while children are seated on it.
action: Consumers who identify Gym Sets as being those involved in the corrective action may call Blazon-Flexible Flyer, Inc. direct on their toll-free line, 1-800-521-6233. They will be supplied with a "retrofit kit" and revised instruction free of charge.
incidents_text: The company has received three reports of injury associated with the product.

heading: Potential Strangulation Hazard Prompts Recall of Chicco Crib Toy
hazard_text: CPSC said five-month-old infants can pull themselves up to a hanging crib toy and become entangled or fall forward over it, possibly strangling. The toy contains no warning about when to remove it from a crib; moreover, the package recommends its use from birth to 18 months of age.
action: Consumers who have the Chicco "Pram Mobile" should return it to the retail store for a refund of the purchase price, or send the toy to Artsana of America, Inc. 200 Fifth Avenue, #910, New York, N.Y. 10010. The firm will refund the purchase price and postage.
incidents_text: While no strangulations or injuries have been reported, Artsana is undertaking this voluntary recall because consumers who read the package instructions may leave the toy in the crib longer than is considered safe.
sold_at: The majority of the toys were sold in Toys R Us Stores.

heading: Toycraft Recalls Stuffed Bear
hazard_text: The eyes and nose come off the bear and are small parts which present a serious choking hazard.
action: Consumers should take the bear away from young children. A full refund will be offered at the store where the bear was purchased.
incidents_text: A 2 year old child died of asphyxiation when the plastic nose from the teddy bear lodged at the base of her larynx.

heading: Perego Offers Repair for Avanti Strollers
hazard_text: An infant seated in the stroller may put his mouth over a metal wire guide that runs parallel to the stroller's arm rest. The child's chin may then be caught in the one-inch space between the wire guide and the arm rest, resulting in lacerations to the mouth, and in some cases, loosening of teeth or loss of teeth.
action: Peg Perego U.S.A., Inc. will provide a free repair kit that will close the gap where children's chins have been caught. The repair kit will not interfere with the stroller's reversible handle feature. To obtain the repair kit and installation instructions, consumers should call Peg Perego toll-free at 1-800-824-4000.
incidents_text: In at least 13 reported instances, an infant seated in the stroller has put his mouth over a metal wire guide that runs parallel to the stroller's arm rest. The child's chin has been caught in the one-inch space between the wire guide and the arm rest, resulting in lacerations to the mouth, and in some cases, loosening of teeth or loss of teeth.

heading: Playpens to be Modified Because of Hazards to Children
hazard_text: Some of the playpens fail to warn users of a potential suffocation hazard if an infant is left in the playpen with one of the sides down. All of the playpens present a finger crushing hazard at two locations in the drop side locking system. In addition, when the playpens are folded for storage, it is possible for a child to remove the plastic feet which may present a choking hazard.
action: C&T International will provide a free modification kit to consumers who call 1-800-537-1922. New Jersey residents call 201-896-2555. The kit contains a Safety Alert warning of the potential suffocation hazard, plastic inserts to prevent the possibility of finger crushing incidents in the folded drop side locking system, and replacement plastic feet which can not be removed by young children. Children should never be left in playpens with the drop sides down. Until owners receive and install the modification kit, the plastic feet should be removed and discarded.
incidents_text: The Commission is aware of a number of deaths and injuries involving mesh-sided playpens with drop sides produced by firms other than C&T. Eleven infants are known to have died when left unattended in playpens with a drop side down. These children suffocated when they rolled into a mesh pocket created by the lowered drop side. The Commission is also aware of several incidents in which children's fingers were crushed when they attempted to climb into a playpen grasping the folded drop side locking system. The playpens involved in these incidents were not manufactured by C&T; however, some of the playpens sold by C&T are similar to the playpens involved in the incidents and present the same hazards.

heading: Umbrella Stroller Recalled
hazard_text: The hazard involves sixteen tube end plugs on each stroller that are considered to be "small parts," which may come out and present a choking hazard to children. In addition, when the plugs are removed, the exposed metal tube ends could have "sharp edges."
action: Service Merchandise is offering a modification kit at no charge to its customers. Consumers having Model 1601 PRT Umbrella Strollers should stop using them, and immediately contact Service Merchandise for a modification kit. To obtain a free modification kit, call toll-free, 1-800- 251-1389. Tennessee residents may call toll-free, 1-800-251-1212. Requests may also be sent to Service Merchandise Company, Customer Relations Department, PO Box 24600, Nashville, Tennessee 37202.
incidents_text: Neither Service Merchandise nor the Commission is aware of any injuries to small children as a result of these small parts and sharp edges.
sold_at: The Umbrella Strollers, Model 1601 PRT, were purchased in Service Merchandise stores from August, 1986 through March, 1987.

product_name: Rainbow Bell baby rattles, Item CT-8013
heading: Li Peng Enterprises Recalls Rainbow Bell Baby Rattles
hazard_text: The rattle presents a choking hazard because the handle is small enough to enter a child's mouth and long enough to reach the back of the throat, and because the metal bell can detach from the top part of the rattle.
action: Consumers should take the rattles away from infants immediately and return the rattles to the retail store where purchased for a full refund of the purchase price.
incidents_text: Neither Li Peng nor the Commission know of any injuries caused by these baby rattles.

product_name: Colorforms #150 Story Book Puzzles, and Crib Pals Shake and Twist Baby Rattles, #098132
heading: Toys-R-Us Recalls Baby Rattle And Colorforms Puzzles
hazard_text: For the Colorforms #150 Story Book Puzzles, some of the pieces of the puzzles are small parts and present a potential choking hazard. For the Crib Pals Shake N' Twist Baby Rattle, the rattler can break during use, and the broken pieces present a potential choking hazard.
action: Consumers should take these toys away from children and return them to any Toys-R-Us store for a full refund of the purchase price.
incidents_text: The CPSC and Toys-R-Us have not received reports of any injuries or deaths involving the Colorforms puzzles or the Shake and Twist baby rattles.
sold_at: The Colorforms #150 Story Book Puzzles were sold nationwide from September '86 to December '87 through Toys-R-Us Stores for approximately $5.97. The Crib Pals Shake N' Twist Baby Rattles were sold nationwide from March '86 to December '87 through Toys-R-Us stores for approximately $1.48.

product_name: Hedstrom and Sears brand wooden baby swings
heading: Hedstrom Offers Free Replacement For Wood Baby Swing
hazard_text: Hedstrom was aware of four reported incidents in which the swings collapsed because glue failed to hold the joints between the slats and frame. One reported incident involved bruises suffered by a child in the swing.
action: Consumers should immediately discontinue using this swing and discard or destroy it. The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available.
incidents_text: Hedstrom was aware of four reported incidents in which the swings collapsed because glue failed to hold the joints between the slats and frame. One reported incident involved bruises suffered by a child in the swing.

heading: Repair Offered For Schaper Manufacturing Co. "Speed Wheels" Riding Toy
hazard_text: Injuries have resulted from entrapment of children's fingers between the pedal bar and the body of the toy.
action: Tyco Toys is offering a free guard kit for approximately 25,000 1986 models sold without guards. Owners of this model should call Tyco at its toll-free number, 800-257-7728 (in New Jersey, call 800-322-8011). They may also write:Speed Wheels Corrective Action Program, Tyco Toys, Inc., 540 Glen Avenue, Moorestown, NJ 08057.
incidents_text: The Schaper "Speed Wheels'' ride-on toys have been associated with eight incidents of laceration or fingertip severance.

heading: Princeton Hosiery Mills Issues Warning On Plastic Ornaments On Infant Socks
hazard_text: The infant socks may present a choking or aspiration hazard if the plastic ornaments, which are small parts, detach from the socks.
action: Consumers who purchased these hosiery items for children under three should immediately remove the teddy bears and/or pearl beads from the socks and discard these ornaments to eliminate potential choking hazards.
incidents_text: Neither CPSC or Le-Roi knows of any injuries involving these socks.

heading: Pacifier Holder Recalled Due to Possibility of Choking Hazard
hazard_text: The small bear figure separated from the strap which in turn could present a potential choking hazard if swallowed by infants.
action: Consumers are urged to take the pacifier holder away from babies immediately and return them for a replacement to the retail store where they were purchased or to Baby Buddies, Inc.
units: Approximately 9,000 of these pacifier holders were distributed nationwide from March 1986 through March 1987.
incidents_text: CPSC nor Baby Buddies know of any injuries involving these pacifier holders.
sold_at: A variety of retailers from October, 1986 to December 4, 1987.

product_name: The wheels on the BMX-12 inch boys bicycle in blue
heading: Replacement Program Announced For Rand Bicycle Wheels
hazard_text: The potential hazard involves wheel rim breakage during the inflation process. When the tire is inflated beyond the recommended P.S.I. (pounds per square inch), the plastic rim may shatter and cause injury to the inflator or to bystanders.
incidents_text: No injuries have been reported.
sold_at: Distributed through Otasco and other small retail chain stores in Eastern, Southern and Southwestern U.S., prior to January 1987.

heading: Miracle Recreation Equipment CO.
hazard_text: The Complaint alleges that Miracle's "Flying Animal Swing", because of the weight, size, and composition of the individual animal swing figures and because of a metal support tube which projects to the rear of each swing, contains a defect which presents a substantial risk of injury to children.
action: Until this matter is resolved, the Commission staff urges the public not to use these swings which are found primarily on public playgrounds around the country. The Flying Animal Swings may be either a pony, seal, lion, or a squirrel.
incidents_text: The Complaint alleges that there have been seven (7) cases of serious head injuries and one (1) fatality when children were struck by the swing.

heading: Baby Cribs Recalled
hazard_text: This type of baby crib is banned because it fails to meet safety requirements with respect to hardware, spacing of crib spindles in slats, decorative cutouts, assembly instructions, labeling, and mattress thickness. Potential hazards include falling from the crib, pinching, laceration, entrapment, and strangulation.
action: Owners of these cribs are urged to immediately remove these cribs from use and return them for a refund to the retailer where purchased.
incidents_text: Neither the Consumer Product Safety Commission nor the firm is aware of any injury associated with these cribs, but the recall is being made as a precaution.

heading: Children's Painted Wooden Puzzles
hazard_text: The paint on the children's wooden painted puzzles contains levels of lead as high as 12.84% and may present a lead poisoning hazard.
action: Consumers should remove those puzzles bought before August 1987 from use by children and return them to the store where they were purchased for a complete refund.
incidents_text: Neither the CPSC nor Little Headworks Company knows of any lead poisoning incidents associated with these puzzles.

heading: Fisher-Price To Modify Strollers
hazard_text: The combination carriage/strollers involved have fabric canopy side panels attached to the seat back with fabric fasteners. The fasteners can detach, leaving an open space when the stroller back is reclined through which an infant's head or body can fall.
action: Fisher-Price will provide a free modification kit that will close the opening and prevent the possibility of a child's head or body falling through. The modification kit will still allow use of the multi-position feature of the seat back. Consumers can obtain the free modification kit with complete installation instructions by calling 800-233-4004 between 8:30 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. EST or by writing to Fisher-Price Consumer Affairs, PO Box 16, East Aurora, New York 14052.
incidents_text: Fisher-Price has received 17 complaints that children's heads or arms protruded through the opening. In two cases the infant fell from the stroller.

heading: United Furniture to Provide Bunk Bed Modification Kit
hazard_text: On United bunk beds sold without cross wires, the mattress and foundation may collapse causing injury or death to a bed occupant or to a child playing under a bed.
action: Consumers should examine their bunk beds. If ledges attached to the bunk bed side rails are the only means of support for the mattress and foundation on either berth, they should call United Furniture collect at 803-879-7373 for a free modification kit.
incidents_text: The Commission is aware of four deaths of children which occurred where the mattress and foundation of bunk beds became dislodged and fell on them. The bunk beds in these incidents were not manufactured by United Furniture. However, bunk beds sold by United Furniture have a mattress support system similar to three of the beds involved in the incidents.

heading: Voluntary Recall of Crib Soft Playgrounds Announced
hazard_text: When strings are not tied tightly or become loosened with use, the string between the toy and the crib may present a potential strangulation hazard if a child were to become entrapped between the toy and the crib or playpen side.
action: Shelcore, Inc., has redesigned the activity center using velcro straps to secure the product close to the wooden crib or wooden playpen side and to prevent attachment to a mesh-sided crib or mesh-sided playpen. To obtain the new activity center free of charge, consumers should mail their old activity center, along with their name, address and telephone number, to Shelcore, Inc., 3474 S. Clinton Ave., S. Plainfield, N.J. 07080. Postage costs will be reimbursed by the firm.
incidents_text: The Commission and the firm are aware of the recent fatal strangulation of a 14 month old Minnesota boy who inserted his head between a loosely tied toy and the mesh on a playpen.

heading: CPSC Warns of Potentially Hazardous Disposable Butane Cigarette Lighters
hazard_text: Certain of these lighters can shoot up excessively high flames or spew butane without lighting or before lighting.
action: Since a consumer cannot readily differentiate between lighters which may exhibit the problem and those which do not, the firm is urging consumers who may still have these lighters in their possession to carefully dispose of them. In disposing of the lighters, consumers are warned to do so in such a way that children will not have access to the discarded lighters.
incidents_text: There have been no injuries reported involving these lighters.

heading: CBS "Wonder" Spring Ride-On Horses Recalled
hazard_text: CBS has received 105 complaints that the body of the toy has broken without warning while being ridden, causing the rider to fall suddenly.
action: Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product. Do not donate or resell.
incidents_text: CBS has received 105 complaints that the body of the toy has broken without warning while being ridden, causing the rider to fall suddenly. Forty of these incidents resulted in injuries such as cuts, scrapes and bruises.

heading: CPSC Announces Voluntary Portable Crib Floorboard Replacement
hazard_text: The drop side may be lowered while the crib is in the "changing table" position, which can cause the floorboard to dislodge, thereby posing fall and injury hazards to infants.
action: Consumers should stop using the portable cribs immediately and call North States Industries collect at 612-522-6505 to receive a free replacement floorboard.
incidents_text: The Commission and the firm are aware of an incident involving a young infant who received a fractured skull when the floorboard of her portable crib was dislodged causing her to fall and strike her head on the floor.

heading: General Mills Stops Sales Of Cheerios With "Powerball" Premium
hazard_text: The company and Commission caution parents that children of approximately three years of age or under may tend to place small objects like the "Powerball" into their mouths, which poses a choking hazard.
action: General Mills is warning parents who purchased 15 and 20 ounce size boxes of Cheerios containing a free "Powerball" premium to keep the premium away from children approximately three years of age or under, or to discard it.
incidents_text: General Mills said the ball was reportedly involved in the accidental choking death of a one-year-old child. Four other incidents involving balls in the mouths of young children that did not result in injury were also reported to the firm.

heading: Recall Warning issued on Windmill Rattle Because of possible Choking Hazard
hazard_text: The rattles pose a potential choking hazard.
action: Consumers who purchased these rattles for children should stop using them immediately and return them to the store where originally purchased for a refund.
incidents_text: Neither CPSC nor the firm is aware of any known injury associated with this rattle.

heading: Stuffed Animal Mobiles Recalled Because Of Strangulation Hazard - Recent Death Cited
hazard_text: When hung within the reach of an infant, a 26-inch nylon cord poses the potential for entanglement and strangulation.
action: Consumers should take the mobiles away from children and cut the 26-inch nylon cord and springs. Send the detached cord and sprints to: Calderon Co., Inc., 480 Forest Avenue, Locust Valley, NY 11560. Calderon will send you a free plush toy in return.
incidents_text: The Commission and the firm are aware of the September 1986 fatal strangulation accident of a 15-month-old Pennsylvania boy. The boy became entangled in the nylon cord attached to the wings of a "Toucan" model which was hung over a crib and post. A label sewn into the mobile, warning against use by children under three, had been removed after purchase.

heading: Stuffed Teddy Bear With Small Parts and Sharp Points
hazard_text: The teddy bear may present a choking and laceration or puncture hazard because of small parts and sharp points.
action: Consumers who bought these teddy bears for children should immediately remove and discard the flowers and wires to eliminate the choking, puncture and laceration hazards.
incidents_text: When the Consumer Product Safety Commission subjected the bears to use and abuse testing the flowers, which are small parts, became detached and the sharp ends of the wire stems were exposed.

heading: Replacement Program Announced For Dynacraft "Magna" Sidewalk Bicycle Wheel Rims
hazard_text: The potential hazard involves wheel rim breakage during the inflation process. If the tire is inflated beyond the recommended 30 psi. there is a possibility that the plastic rims may shatter and strike the user or bystander which may cause injury.
action: Consumers may obtain a replacement of the affected wheel rims free of charge by returning the entire bicycle to the Child World store from which it was purchased. The bicycle itself need not be replaced, but consumers must return the bicycle to obtain a replacement for the wheel rims.
incidents_text: Dynacraft and the Commission are not aware of any incidents involving injury with this product, but because laboratory tests have indicated the potential for breakage with the Model #8522 "Magna", Dynacraft has offered to replace the plastic wheel rims with non-plastic rims.

heading: Safety Recall Of Shoulder Harness On Championship Brand Bicycle Child Carrier Sold by Sears
hazard_text: The plastic buckle on some of the shoulder harnesses may unbuckle or disengage during use and a child could fall from the carrier.
action: Consumers may order a new shoulder harness free-of-charge from D&R Industries, Inc., 7111 Capitol Drive, Lincolnwood, IL 60645 by calling toll-free 1-800-323-2852 or residents of Illinois, Hawaii, Alaska may call 312-677-3200 collect.
incidents_text: D&R Industries is aware of six reported instances where the buckle failed to engage. Parents are cautioned not to use the carrier until the shoulder harness buckle is replaced.

heading: Musical Crib Mobile Recalled
hazard_text: The red paint on the clear plastic rings of the toy contains approximately 8% lead. This paint flakes off easily, posing a lead poisoning hazard to children.
action: Consumers owning the recalled units should immediately take them from their children's reach and return them to the store where purchased for a complete refund or exchange. They may also return the toy to Woodcrafter Kits, Inc., 42A North Elm Street, Yarmouth, Maine 04096 for a refund of $20.00, plus postage.
incidents_text: Neither CPSC nor Woodcrafter know of any lead poisoning incidents associated with this toy.

product_name: Play Mates baby rattles (both Item No. 203719); Centipede Pull Along toy (Item No. TA-1670); See-Thru Wheel Cart (Item 332); Happy Duck Pull Toy (L Model TM-861); and Hammer Car (Item 160393)
heading: Pay 'N Save Recalls Hazardous Toys
hazard_text: The rattles and toys violate CPSC safety requirements and present choking hazards.
action: Pay 'n Save and the Consumer Product Safety Commission urge consumers who have these toys to take them away from children immediately and discard them or return them to a Pay 'n Save store for a refund of the purchase price.
units: Approximately 3,400 of each type of rattle
incidents_text: One incident has been reported in which the balls on the string broke, and a 7 month old child put a plastic pellet from the ball in his mouth. The child was not injured.

heading: INFANT WALKERS RECALLED
hazard_text: The seat and strap designs could result in injury to a child.
action: McCrory will provide a full refund to all owners of the Model PHT417.
incidents_text: McCrory is recalling these walkers as a result of 30 incidents of crotch strap slippage or disengagement and tearing or stretching of the seat material, which could allow an infant to fall through the seat to -1 the floor and become caught or entangled. One incident of crotch strap slippage is known to have resulted in a broken collar bone.
sold_at: McCrory, T.G. & Y, J.J. Newberry, McLellan, H.L. Green, Kress, Silver, Elmore, Britts, and Kittinger as well as other retail stores nationwide.

heading: Children's Lawn Chair Being Recalled
hazard_text: In some instances children's fingers may become caught when the chairs are collapsed.
action: Consumers are urged to remove the chair from use immediately. To obtain a $5.00 refund for the product, consumers should cut the entire fabric seat and back from the chair and mail them both, along with their name, address and telephone number, to Action Industries, P.O. Box 116, Cheswick, Pa 15024. Refunds will be made only for chairs which match the description above. Owners are also advised to dispose of the chair frame after the fabric seat has been removed.
incidents_text: Twenty-two incidents have been reported in which children's fingers became caught when the chair was collapsed. In some cases severe laceration or loss of fingertip was reported.

heading: CPSC & Perego Products Announce Repair Program
hazard_text: The Walkie walkers contain a plastic height adjustment mechanism for the seat which allows it to be raised and lowered. In at least five instances, the plastic height adjustment mechanism has fractured, collapsing the walker and allowing the infant in the walker to fall to the ground.
action: Perego Products will provide free to owners a repair kit which will prevent the collapse of the seat. Until owners receive and install the repair kit, the walker should not be used.
incidents_text: The Commission is aware of one minor-injury to an infant using the-walker.

heading: WARNING ISSUED ON LITTLE PRO GARMENTS BECAUSE OF POSSIBLE CHOKING HAZARD
hazard_text: The two piece garment for children under three years of age contain small parts which could be a choking hazard.
action: Consumers who purchased these garments for children under three should immediately remove the stars from the shirt and discard them to eliminate potential choking hazards.
incidents_text: Neither the CPSC, nor the N.Y.A.G., nor Elkay Industries, Inc., knows of any injuries involving these garments.

heading: Toy Train & Music Box Recalled because of Lead in the Paint
hazard_text: Wood Toy Train and Toy Chest Music Box present an of excess lead in the paint on these items.
action: Consumers should stop using these items and discard them or return them to the retailer where purchased for a full refund.
units: Approximately 900 of the Wood Trains and 900 of the Toy Chest
incidents_text: Neither the Consumer Product Safety Commission nor Enesco have received any reports of lead poisoning from either of these toys.

heading: Baby Walker Recall
hazard_text: The models involved have a white vinyl binding tape on the edges of the crotch strap. The hazard involves slippage of the strap through the buckle which secures the front of the walker's seat to its deck. This slippage could result in infant entrapment or injury.
action: Service Merchandise is offering a free replacement seat at no charge to the consumer and urges all owners of the Model 106 FLP walker to participate in the recall. The model number is located on the ID tag on the seat.
incidents_text: The Commission and Service Merchandise are aware of at least 5 incidents involving seat strap slippage, one of which was associated with an infant death.

heading: Animal Voices Musical Toys Recalled Because of Choking Hazard
hazard_text: They have small parts which are a choking hazard. Tests conducted by CPSC show that when the toys are dropped, the metal noisemakers and springs, which are small parts, detach.
action: Although the CPSC and Toys-R-Us have not received reports of any injuries or deaths involving this toy, consumers should take these toys away from children and return them to any Toys-R-Us store for full refund of the purchase price.
incidents_text: None reported
sold_at: Sold nationwide through Toys-R-Us stores from April, 1985 to December, 1986 for approximately $1.48.

heading: Dellano's Mexican Products Co., Inc. Recalls Children's Chairs
hazard_text: The paint on the chairs contains levels of lead as high as 1.15% and may present a lead poisoning hazard. No more than 0.06% is allowed by CPSC requirements.
action: Consumers should remove these chairs from use by children and return them to the store where they were purchased for a complete refund.
incidents_text: Neither the CPSC nor De Llano's Mexican Products Co. knows of any lead poisoning incidents associated with these chairs.

heading: Baby Furniture Outlet Baby Cribs and Playpens Present Hazard to Infants
hazard_text: The cribs, distributed nationwide, failed to meet one or more CPSC safety requirements with respect to dimensions, spacing of crib components, hardware, construction, and assembly instructions or labeling. Not all cribs present the same hazard but hazards, which may be present, include strangulation, head entrapment, pinching, laceration and falling.
action: Since Baby Furniture Outlet is currently involved in bankruptcy proceedings and liquidation, the company maintains that it is unable to bear the costs of recalling any cribs or playpens.
incidents_text: CPSC is aware of 19 incidents with the cribs, several involving bruises and 2 incidents involving the playpens.

heading: Toy Importers Initiate Limited Recall of An Ambi Mini Racer
hazard_text: The hat is a small part which could present a choking hazard to children younger than three.
action: Consumers should remove this hat from the Ambi Mini Racer immediately and return it to the retail store where purchased for the $1.00 premium.
incidents_text: The CPSC is not aware of any report of deaths or injuries involving this toy.

heading: Columbia Cascade To Repair Timberform 4000 Series Playground Equipment
hazard_text: Children can become entrapped in the spaces between the metal ladder rungs and the wooden platform deck.
action: Anyone who believes they own the equipment involved in this program may contact Columbia Cascade for assistance in identifying the equipment and obtaining information about repairs.
incidents_text: The Commission and he firm are aware of at least 4 instances of head entrapment in these play structures. No injuries have been reported. All the reported incidents occurred during supervised play.

heading: Replacement Program Announced For Roadmaster Corporation 12" Sidewalk Bicycles W/Plastic Wheels
hazard_text: The hazard involves a wheel breakage problem which may occur when the tire is inflated significantly beyond the recommended inflation pressure.
action: Roadmaster is replacing, free of charge, all affected sidewalk bicycle wheels. Only models 9693-KM & 7973-KM sidewalk bicycles are involved in this free replacement.
incidents_text: Roadmaster and the Commission have been informed of two incidents where minor injuries occurred when plastic "mag" wheels broke during tire inflation.
sold_at: Both of the affected models were sold nationwide by Kmart retail stores.

heading: Flying Toy Helicopter Being Recalled
hazard_text: CPSC has investigated accidents in which this toy has been responsible for serious eye injuries and facial lacerations not only to children but adults as well.
action: Consumers are urged to discontinue use and to return the toy helicopter to the store where it was purchased for a full refund.
incidents_text: The toy, imported by many firms, has been responsible for eye injuries and facial lacerations. Some of the injuries have resulted in permanent blindness.

heading: Stuffed Toy Bears Recalled Because Of Small Parts
hazard_text: The toy bears have small parts which could present a choking hazard.
action: Consumers should return the NIKE stuffed bears to the footwear department of the nearest Mervyn's store. A certificate for a $5 credit on the next purchase of NIKE athletic footwear from Mervyn's will be issued for each NIKE bear returned.
incidents_text: No reported injuries involving these toys.
sold_at: The stuffed bears were imported by Superior for NIKE and distributed with NIKE athletic shoes in a "free gift with purchase" promotion Sept.4-14 by Mervyn's department stores in Arizona, California, Colorado, Louisiana, Nevada, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington.

heading: Certain Voltron Lion Toys To Be Recalled And Exchanged Because Of A Potential Lead Paint Hazard
hazard_text: Certain paints on the metal parts on both sizes of Voltron Lions contain levels of lead which are higher than that which is allowed by law. These toys are, therefore, banned.
action: Consumers are advised to remove the toys from use immediately and to call a toll free number to obtain a new replacement Voltron
units: Approximately 203,000 complete sets and 424,000 pieces of Deluxe Voltron Lions and 866,000 Miniature Voltron Lions
incidents_text: None Reported

heading: "McDonald's and CPSC Announce Exchange for LEGO Building Set Toys Because of Choking Hazard"
hazard_text: These sets contain small parts which could present a hazard if given to children younger than three.
action: Customers with children younger than three who received LEGO Building Sets at McDonald's Restaurants between October 31 and November 7 are to exchange them for DUPLO Building Sets designed by the LEGO Company for children under three.
incidents_text: No incidents have been reported with any building sets distributed at McDonald's during this time.
sold_at: McDonald's

heading: Wooden Toy Fire Trucks Recalled Because Of Choking Hazard
hazard_text: Tests conducted by CPSC showed that the firemen figures, which detach from the truck, are small parts and present a choking hazard.
action: Consumers may return the toy-for a full refund to the retail store where they were purchased or to Marlon Creations, Inc., 35-01 36th Avenue, Long Island City, New York 11106.
incidents_text: None reported.

heading: Baby Rattles Recalled Because Of Choking Hazard
hazard_text: When the CPSC tested these rattles they were found to have handles which are small enough to enter an infant's mouth and lodge in the throat causing a choking or suffocation hazard.
action: Consumers are urged to take the rattles away from babies immediately and return them for a full refund to the retail store where they were purchased or to U.S. Toy Company, Inc., 1227 East 119th Street, Grandview, Missouri 64030.
incidents_text: None Reported

heading: Johnson & Johnson Crib Toys Case Settled
CPSC Accepts Consent Agreements from Toy Importers
Baby Toys Recalled Because of Choking Hazard
hazard_text: The toy poses danger of choking or suffocation to infants and young children.
action: Consumers should remove these products from use immediately and either discard them or return them to the retailer where purchased for a full refund.
incidents_text: Neither CPSC nor Strauss of any injuries involving these toys.

heading: My Baby Pumpkin Dolls Recalled Because of Choking Hazard
hazard_text: Tests conducted by the CPSC showed that the dolls' hands detach and are small enough to be a choking hazard.
action: Consumers may return them for a full refund to the retailer where they were purchased.
incidents_text: Although the CPSC and S & H Wholesale have not received any reports of injuries involving this toy, consumers should take these dolls away from children immediately.

heading: Flying Toy Helicopter Being Recalled
hazard_text: CPSC has investigated accidents in which this toy has been responsible for serious eye injuries and facial lacerations not only to children but adults as well.
action: Consumers are urged to discontinue use and to return the toy helicopter to the store where it was purchased for a full refund.
incidents_text: CPSC has investigated accidents in which this toy has been responsible for serious eye injuries and facial lacerations not only to children but adults as well.

heading: CPSC Warns of Dropside Mesh-Sided Crib Dangers
hazard_text: These cribs and playpens present an asphyxiation and suffocation hazard when a child is left in one of these products with a side down.

heading: Play Brooms Recalled Because Of Lead Paint Hazard
hazard_text: Paint on the brooms' handles contains an excess of lead.
action: The Commission and Come Play Products Company urge teachers and parents to remove these brooms from use immediately and either discard them or return them for a refund to the retailer where purchased.
incidents_text: The Consumer Product Safety Commission knows of one incident involving a child who had ingested paint from the broom's handle but was unable conclusively to attribute the child's elevated blood lead level to the toy.

heading: Repair Program To Prevent Injury From Bassinet Collapse Announced
hazard_text: The bassinets are being recalled due to the possible collapse of their leg braces.The Commission believes that serious injury can occur to an infant resting in the bassinet, if the leg brace were to collapse.
action: During use of the bassinet, ensure that leg braces are locked in the open position. Periodically check the leg braces especially if the bassinet has not been used for a time and has been folded up in storage.
incidents_text: The Commission and Badger have investigated 7 instances in which the braces connecting the foldable legs to the bassinet collapsed.

heading: Flying Toy Helicopter Being Recalled
hazard_text: CPSC has investigated accidents in which this toy has been responsible for serious eye injuries and facial lacerations not only to children but adults as well.
action: Consumers are urged to discontinue use and to return the toy helicopter to the store where it was purchased for a full refund.

heading: Miracle Recreation Equipment Company To Repair "Flying Gym" Playground Swings
hazard_text: The parts on the swing set are not secure.
action: The firm will provide needed parts, without charge, for the repair and an allowance of $50.00 for welding costs.
incidents_text: A ten-year-old boy in Seattle, Washington died from injuries received after part of a "Flying Gym" swing fell and struck him in December 1984.

heading: Issues Complaint Seeking Recall Of Johnson & Johnson Crib Toys
hazard_text: The crib toys pose a strangulation hazard to infants.
action: The staff believes these toys are dangerous and should be removed from cribs and playpens immediately.
incidents_text: The Complaint alleges two young children have strangled on the toys. A 10 month old boy died in Temple Hills, Maryland, in October, 1984, when he became entangled in the strings tying a Soft Triplet toy across his crib. A seven month old girl died in Coronado, California in December, 1985, when she was caught by the neck on top of a Triplet stretched across her crib.
sold_at: Over 1.6 million Soft Triplets were sold by mail order from 1979 to March of 1986 through magazines such as Parents, American Baby, and Baby Talk.

heading: Flying Helicopter Toy Being Recalled
hazard_text: The toy is being recalled due to a possible eye injury and facial laceration hazard.
action: Consumers are urged not to use the helicopter and to return it for a $3.00 refund to their nearest Woolworth store.

heading: Children's Expandable Enclosures Recalled
Consumers Were Urged to Repair Stroller Shoulder Harness
hazard_text: Some of these consumers indicated that children's necks may be dangerously entangled on the shoulder harness. This entanglement may occur when the activities of the child cannot be seen by the person pushing the stroller and could result in serious injury.
action: Replacement straps are no longer available. Consumers should discard or destroy the product.

heading: CPSC Issues Warning On 12 Inch Teddy Bear Dangers
hazard_text: The bears have small parts which could be a choking hazard and sharp wires which could cause lacerations or puncture wound injuries.
action: Consumers who bought these teddy bears for children should immediately remove and discard the balls and wires to eliminate the choking, puncture and laceration hazards. Retailers should do the same to any teddy bears they have in stock.

heading: Five Importers Recall Ambi Jack in the Ball Toy
hazard_text: Under use and abuse testing, the button (belly button) which activates the jack could fall out, becoming a potential choking hazard for young children.
action: Consumers should remove this toy from use immediately and return it to the retailer where purchased for a full refund.
incidents_text: The CPSC is not aware of any reports of injuries involving this toy.

heading: Second Death Moves Sears To Step Up Brawny Bed Recall
hazard_text: The mattress assembly can dislodge and cause severe injury and/or death.
action: The free modification kit was developed to help prevent the mattress assembly from falling through the bed frame. It consists of four metal cross wires. Two cross wires are to be securely fastened from one side rail to the other on each bed. The kits will be shipped free of charge from the manufacturer directly to consumer.
units: Only about 25,000 of about 112,000 Brawny owners have ordered the modification kit.
incidents_text: The recently reported second death involved a 21-month-old Pennsylvania child reportedly playing under a Brawny bunk bed with his 3-year-old brother in September 1985. The mattress assembly was dislodged and fell on the younger child. The bunk beds were set up as twin beds at the time of the accident, but did not have cross wires to prevent the mattress assembly from falling through the bed frame. In December 1983, a two-year-old Denver boy died under similar circumstances.

heading: Wooden Toy Horses Recalled Because Of Lead Poisoning Hazard
hazard_text: The wooden horses pose a danger of lead poisoning to children.
action: Consumers should stop using the Woodworks Lace Up Horse and discard it or return it to the retailer where purchased for a full refund.
incidents_text: Neither CPSC nor Reeves know of any injuries or deaths associated with this product.

heading: Plaid Enterprises, Inc. Recalls 20,650 Bottles Of Folkart Extender #947
hazard_text: This adult craft product is being recalled because ethylene glycol was used in the formulation of this product instead of propylene glycol. The ingestion of the entire contents of the ethylene glycol product by a small child could result in death.
sold_at: The product is sold at a retail price of about $1.59 and is distributed through craft stores and the craft departments of various other retail outlets.

heading: Sweatshirts Recalled Because Of Possible Choking Hazard
hazard_text: The sweaters have a potential choking hazard presented by LED lights and button-size batteries on a removable velcro strip. When these sweatshirts were tested for compliance with CPSC safety requirements, the LED lights and disc-battery components separated from the velcro strip.
action: Consumers have the option of returning the sweatshirts to TMR for a full refund or to return the velcro strip and keep the sweatshirt for a partial refund of $5.00.

heading: Sharp Industrial Chemical Supply, Inc., Fails To Properly Package Antifreeze
hazard_text: This recall is being undertaken because gallon-sized containers of "Proven Value Antifreeze" were distributed with incorrect labeling and without the child-resistant closures (CRCS) required by federal law.
action: Consumers who have unused containers of "Proven Value Antifreeze" should return the containers to the place of purchase and request replacement units and/or approved CRCS to be affixed to these containers.
incidents_text: The Commission is aware of no cases of accidental ingestion of "Proven Value Antifreeze."

heading: "Official Chopper 9" Flying Toy Helicopter warned by Whimports
hazard_text: It is this assembly which is difficult and if done improperly could allow the rotor blades to come off and cause possible facial lacerations or serious eye injury.
action: Consumers are urged to discontinue use and to return either the three rotor blades or the entire toy helicopter to Whimports. Whimports will replace the returned blades with a redesigned rotor assembly and if the entire toy helicopter is returned, it will be replaced with a new toy helicopter with a redesigned rotor assembly.
